platform.name: UniScope LK
platform.tagline: Higher Education Directory & UGC Admissions Intelligence for Sri Lanka
platform.description: An independent higher education reference portal providing verified UGC cut-off marks, degree programme curricula, university directory, and academic tools for Sri Lankan students.
platform.hero_subtitle: Verified degree programmes, university directories, and official UGC cut-off analysis in one place.
verified_sources: UGC Sri Lanka Admission Student Handbook 2025/2026

developer.name: Farhan NM
developer.title: Founder & Developer — UniScope LK
developer.education: Third-Year Electrical & Electronic Engineering Undergraduate, Faculty of Engineering, University of Jaffna, Sri Lanka
developer.bio: Farhan NM is an Electrical & Electronic Engineering undergraduate at the University of Jaffna and the founder of UniScope LK and SolarCalc LK. Passionate about engineering, technology, and digital innovation, he developed UniScope LK to make Sri Lankan university information easier to access, explore, and compare. Through his projects, he aims to create practical digital solutions that support education and technological development.

platform.disclaimer: UniScope LK is an independent educational information platform and is not an official University Grants Commission service. Minimum selection cut-off marks are historical thresholds from prior academic years and do not guarantee admission in future cycles. Critical admission decisions should always be verified against official UGC publications at www.ugc.ac.lk.
